name: ground-host
notes: The Undercroft Host vehicles, walkers and command (plan/gargoyle-army-style-guide.md, Tier A plus the refreshed Tympanum and the four threat vehicles): per-unit V/W/K blocks with five authored hull headings (90-180 degrees, mirrored; the Chapterhouse three), the articulated layer at five angles (the Carillon cradle tilts), channel-fill, lights and damage overlays, unearthing arrivals, wrecks, rubble and debris cuts (plan/ground-unit-animation.md). Packed per sector with the sector stone ramp and kit baked in (this settles gargoyle-ground-army decision 4 as baked variants). Replaces the 16 x 12 single-atlas layout planned in gargoyle-ground-army 2.2. Every value is an input to tools/ground_blocks (Go). Colours: the sector stone, demon_steel, demon_gilt, demon_warm and smoke; ally_cyan is forbidden. The threat vehicles (Gutter-runner, Scrapmason Crawler, Kiln Ox, Belfry) get headings too (operator, 2026-11-14: no flag, fix forward); their telegraph frames keep the ground-forces.png contract: special f0 launcher raised, f1 glow, f2 launch flash, f3 smoking, so the difficulty contract (plan/difficulty-calibration.md) is unchanged.

krybor.note: Frost slate; captured human hulls keep old grey-blue patches

hollow.note: Verdigris stone, hue <= 155 and low chroma; damp lower band

style_prompt: pixel art, 16-bit arcade game sprite, crisp square pixels, limited palette, original artwork, centered, isolated, solid flat green background (#00FF00), no checkerboard, single war machine seen from a high three-quarter view, night lighting, carved dark stone with chisel facets, cast iron bands, lead roof plates, chains, dark low-contrast stone, glowing ember-orange eyes and carved spout mouth, a glowing slag channel along its back, friendly-scary gothic cathedral masonry
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, logo, signature, ui, frame, border, blurry, photo, photorealistic, smooth gradient, multiple views, character sheet, grid, sky, horizon, ground, landscape, scenery, crowd, many objects, cyan, teal, blue lights, insect, chitin, tentacles, slime, flesh, blood, gore, cross, religious symbol, real military vehicle
